messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-21625: p95 latency SLO breached for route /v1/generate in region us-west-2. threshold=600ms current_p95=1120ms. Automatic fallback to variant 'gpt-8-q' performed. Paging: @Ava (oncall).

Ava (oncall): I'm on it, jumping in. Any initial customer impact reports?

Jon W: Seeing repeated variant flips in the router logs — routing engine bouncing between 'gpt-8' and 'gpt-8-q' about every 20-40s. Looks like fallback cooldown/hysteresis too low.

Priya N: Policy 'latency-fallback-v2' was modified ~2h ago (deploy-bot shows change by Priya). New config set cooldown_seconds=20 and fallback_weight=1.0. That seems aggressive.

Marta R: Also seeing region failover: us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> us-west-2 -> ... Cycle creates cross-region tails and pushes p95 up. The fallback logic is not respecting recent success windows.

infra-bot: router.log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T04:11:02Z router[select] route=/v1/generate region=us-west-2 selected=gpt-8-q fallback_count=7 cooldown=20s p95=1.12s
2026-03-15T04:11:24Z router[select] route=/v1/generate region=us-west-2 selected=gpt-8 fallback_count=0 cooldown=20s p95=0.58s
2026-03-15T04:11:52Z router[select] route=/v1/generate region=us-west-2 selected=gpt-8-q fallback_count=8 cooldown=20s p95=1.10s
```

Priya N: That log pattern = sawtooth. The new policy reduces cooldown so fallback can re-evaluate too quickly and flip back when p95 dips briefly. Also fallback_weight=1.0 forces traffic to the slower variant which worsens the next window.

Ava (oncall): Proposal: temporarily pin /v1/generate to the known stable variant 'gpt-8' in us-west-2 to stop the oscillation and buy time. Then increase policy hysteresis and lower fallback weight. Any objections?

Jon W: Agreed. I'll pin for 15m and then we can make config changes. Command: `/admin route pin --route /v1/generate --variant gpt-8 --region us-west-2 --duration 900`

deploy-bot: Executing pin command...
deploy-bot: Pin applied: /v1/generate -> gpt-8 @ us-west-2 (duration 900s).

Ava (oncall): Monitoring metrics now. Priya, please prepare a config patch to increase cooldown and adjust weights.

Priya N: Draft diff below:
```
- cooldown_seconds: 20
- fallback_weight: 1.0
- success_window_seconds: 30
+ cooldown_seconds: 300  # 5m
+ fallback_weight: 0.1   # prefer primary unless sustained failure
+ success_window_seconds: 120
```

Marta R: Also recommend adding a minimum evaluation window (don't react to sub-minute blips) and require two consecutive evaluation intervals before a full fallback. Will write RFC for the policy safeguards.

infra-bot: Metric update: 60s after pin p95(us-west-2) = 420ms, error rate unchanged. Cross-region failover traces stopped.

Alex (cs): CS update: Two customers (acct: acme-co, acct: brightlearn) flagged elevated latencies between 04:05-04:18 UTC. No 5xxs. I've messaged both with a brief explanation and expected mitigation ETA.

Ava (oncall): Good. We should also note cost impact — pinning to non-quant variant increased cost by ~12% during the pin window. Acceptable as short-term mitigation.

Jon W: Applying Priya's patch to staging now, will roll to prod behind a canary (10% traffic) after 5m observation.

deploy-bot: Config patch applied to staging for policy 'latency-fallback-v2'. Canary rollout pending.

Ava (oncall): After canary looks stable, roll to prod and remove the temporary pin. Keep oncall until next handoff.

Jon W: Canary pass at +6m. No flips observed on canary. Rolling to prod now.

deploy-bot: Policy updated in prod. cooldown_seconds=300 fallback_weight=0.1 success_window_seconds=120.

infra-bot: Observability: prod p95(us-west-2) decayed from 1.12s -> 470ms over 7m post-deploy. Flip events reduced from ~1 per 30s to 0 in the last 10m.

Ava (oncall): Great. Opening follow-up tickets: 1) RFC for routing policy defaults + rollout guard (Marta). 2) Add regression test in the eval harness to simulate short spikes and ensure hysteresis prevents flips (Priya). 3) Postmortem write-up with customer impact summary (Ava).

Marta R: I'll own the RFC. ETA EOD.

Priya N: I'll add the test and link it to CI gating.

Ava (oncall): Handoff: Jon W will take next oncall at 05:00 UTC. Notes: policy rolled back to safer defaults, temporary pin removed, watch for cost rise if we change variants. If flips reappear escalate to infra oncall.

Jon W: Acknowledged. I have metrics dashboards pinned and will monitor for 2h.

Ava (oncall): Thanks team. Closing the pager but keeping thread open for postmortem updates. :white_check_mark:
